A steady hand for our town
## A doctor's discipline. A neighbor's heart.
For 22 years, Los Altos Hills has been Jasmeen's family home and safe haven. She is running to preserve the qualities residents value most while planning responsibly for the future.

In their own words
## Leadership rooted in service
Jasmeen has earned the trust of community leaders through thoughtful listening, steady collaboration, and a genuine commitment to Los Altos Hills.
“
I have seen Jasmeen at work on the Parks & Rec Committee. She shows up, does the work, and inspires others. She is thoughtful, smart, pleasant and egoless. I am honored to endorse her for City Council.
“
I am pleased to endorse Jasmeen Pombra for Los Altos Hills Town Council. Through her many years of service on the Parks, Recreation and Community Events Committee, including her leadership as Chair, Jasmeen has demonstrated a genuine commitment to our residents and to making our Town an even stronger community.
Jasmeen is a thoughtful and engaged leader who listens to different perspectives, asks important questions, and works collaboratively to move ideas forward. She brings both energy and a practical, solutions-oriented approach to her work. I believe Jasmeen will be a strong and effective voice for our residents, and I am happy to support her for Town Council.
“
I am proud to endorse Jasmeen Pombra for Los Altos Hills Town Council. I have had the opportunity to work with Jasmeen through her six years of service on the Parks, Recreation and Community Events Committee, including the last three years as Chair. I have seen firsthand her dedication to our Town, her strong work ethic, and her ability to listen thoughtfully and bring people together.
Jasmeen does her homework, approaches issues with an open mind, and is committed to preserving the unique character of Los Altos Hills while thoughtfully planning for our future. I am confident she will bring the same energy, sound judgment, and commitment to the Town Council.
“
Both in her professional and volunteer roles, Jasmeen has proven her leadership. She's informed, listens well, is a great communicator, and makes good decisions. These are essential qualities on the Los Altos Hills City Council and I enthusiastically endorse her!
“
Working with Jasmeen Pombra has been a real joy in my role as City Council liaison to the Parks and Rec Committee. She brings a steady, reliable presence to every meeting and a genuine warmth that makes collaboration easy. Jasmeen’s care for the community shows in the thoughtful details she puts into each project and in the way she brings people together. She’s someone who consistently makes our work better simply by how she shows up.
“
I want to express our endorsement of Dr. Jasmeen Pombra for Town Council. As members of our Parks, Recreation and Community Events team, we’ve had the ability to work closely with Jasmeen as Chair. She brings a sense of belonging and elicits a strong sense of community, engagement and warmth, listens to all points of view, always with a smile and positive attitude. We believe that she will be a strong asset to the Town Council and carry forth our Town assets, rural attitudes and spirit in a dedicated, mindful way.
“
I am truly honored to have had the opportunity to work with Jasmeen Pombra. Her dedication to our committee and, especially, her vision for bringing our community together in a changing world have deeply impressed and inspired me.
During her time as Chair of the Parks and Recreation and Community Events Committee, Jasmeen has made a genuine effort to listen to and represent all voices—from young families and newer residents to those who have called Los Altos Hills home for decades. She has a remarkable ability to find common ground, respect different perspectives, and focus on solutions that benefit the broader community.
What I appreciate most about Jasmeen is her belief that we can move forward while still honoring the traditions and character that make Los Altos Hills special. I have no doubt that she will continue to make a positive impact and help bring our community closer together while preserving the values and traditions we cherish.
“
I was fortunate to meet Jasmeen during my time as a council member. Now I’m even more fortunate to call her a dear friend. She is the kind of person we want on the council: thoughtful, smart and kind. She will listen to everyone and consider all options. I feel confident that she will be an excellent council member. She has my full endorsement.
“
I’ve known Jasmeen for a number of years as a fellow resident and have watched her grow in her role as a member and then Chair of the Parks and Recreation Committee. She brings a genuine interest in the welfare of the Town and a strong commitment to volunteering. She is always willing to listen and will bring a strong voice to the Town Council as we navigate complex issues such as ubiquitous broadband connectivity, fire prevention, and safety and security.
“
Jasmeen Pombra brings sharp analytical skills and a deep connection to our community — exactly what we need on our City Council. Her years as a Town committee volunteer have given her a firsthand understanding of how vital residents are to the work of running Los Altos Hills. Please join me in supporting Jasmeen Pombra for Los Altos Hills City Council.
